predecessors.note: 'Named by Boniface of Montferrat' to rule Salona, 'under the Kingdom of Thessalonica' (Thomas I d'Autremencourt).

successors.note: 1394: 'the town opened its gates to the Ottoman sultan Bayezid I' because of the unpopularity of the Dowager Countess Helena Asanina Kantakouzene. About 1402 Salona 'fell for a short time into the hands of the Despotate of the Morea'; Theodore I 'sold Salona to the Knights Hospitaller in 1404'; 'it fell again to the Ottomans in 1410'.

capitals.name: Salona (Amfissa)
capitals.note: Infobox 'Capital: Salona (modern Amfissa; French La Sole, Italian La Sola)'.

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no row). 'Salona and its surroundings in Central Greece'; the page does not mention Delphi or Lidoriki and gives no area. A 25 km radius is an upper bound.

ledger.note: 1205: Boniface of Montferrat names Thomas I d'Autremencourt lord of Salona, under the Kingdom of Thessalonica.

About 1210: Epirus occupies Salona. 'c. 1210-1212: Epirote occupation was short-lived, after which Salona became a vassal of the Principality of Achaea.' The page gives no more detail on the occupation.

About 1212: the Epirote occupation ends and Salona becomes an Achaean vassal ('a vassal of the Principality of Achaea'); the page later notes an 'increasing dependency from the Duchy of Athens' without a date.

1318: the Catalan Fadrique family takes the lordship. 'In 1318, the lordship came under the rule of the Catalan Fadrique family'; it becomes the County of Salona. The page labels 1380 the 'Navarrese Conquest' and has the Count of Salona rank first among eighteen Catalan vassals in 1380-81.

1394: Salona opens its gates to Bayezid I. 'In 1394, the town opened its gates to the Ottoman sultan Bayezid I', because of the unpopularity of the Dowager Countess Helena Asanina Kantakouzene (Maria Fadrique had reigned from 1382 under her mother's regency).
1394: the Lordship (County) of Salona ends as a Frankish state; the town is Ottoman, then briefly the Despotate of the Morea's (c. 1402), the Hospitallers' (1404) and again Ottoman (1410).

certainty.note: A small march around Salona; no page gives limits.

sources.title: Lordship of Salona
sources.note: Creation 1205, Epirote occupation c.1210-1212, Fadrique 1318, 1380-81, Bayezid 1394, Morea c.1402, Hospitallers 1404, Ottomans 1410. No area.

notes: Written by eu-05-x (additions). Cliopatria has no row; slug free. eu-05-e suggested a separate 'county-of-salona' (Catalan, 1380-1390); the Lordship page treats the lordship and the County of Salona (from 1318) as one state, so this dossier covers both. One page opened (budget 1-2); no war pages. Not settled: (1) the Achaean suzerainty from c.1212 and the Athenian dependency are vassal relations for the Achaea and Athens dossiers (vassal_start/vassal_end with counterpart lordship-of-salona); (2) the 1380 'Navarrese Conquest' is the page's label with no territorial detail; (3) Salona after 1394 (Morea c.1402, Hospitallers 1404-1410): recorded in the despotate-of-the-morea and hospitaller-rhodes dossiers; (4) no area, no list of lords.
